note: MSRP excludes destination. No model-year pricing releases could be located on media.ford.com, so every year uses the cars.com research trims page ('Starting MSRP' per trim and drivetrain, reflecting the latest in-year price) as the row source; launch-time prices and destination charges come from dated secondary articles and are recorded in notes. Rows: each trim in its cheapest drivetrain (FWD/RWD where offered), the other drivetrain's price in the note; a separate XLT 4WD row is included for 2016-2020 where the trim count allowed. Trim names as Ford writes them (Base = unnamed 'Explorer' trim; Limited Hybrid rows added where a fetched source priced them). 2025 refresh replaced Base/XLT/Limited/Timberline/King Ranch with Active/ST-Line/Platinum/ST; Tremor added for 2026.

gaps: No manufacturer (media.ford.com) pricing source for any year 2016-2026; all 11 years are secondary (cars.com rows, with Autoblog/AutoGuide/Ford Authority/KBB/Yahoo-syndicated articles for destination and launch prices).

Destination charge not stated by any fetched source for 2018, 2019 and 2023 (null). 2016 ($895), 2017 ($945), 2020 ($1,095 at launch; $1,245 by Aug 2020), 2021 ($1,245), 2022 ($1,295), 2024 ($1,595), 2025 ($1,595) and 2026 ($1,695; $1,595 before Sept 2025) are from secondary articles (Autoblog, Ford Authority, KBB).
2026: Ford Authority's Sept 2025 Tremor price ($48,465) is $500 below cars.com ($48,965); every other 2026 trim matches. Unresolved.
2016, 2017, 2020-2022, 2025: cars.com figures are $130-$2,425 above the dated launch/announcement prices (mid-year increases); both recorded.

2020-2023: cars.com attaches the 3.3L hybrid engine label to Limited and Platinum rows whose prices match the gas trims (2020, 2021 Limited) or sit between gas and hybrid figures (2022 Platinum); engine labels on those rows are unreliable. Limited Hybrid is priced only for 2020-2022 (Ford Authority/KBB) and Platinum Hybrid only in notes (2021-2022).
2021: the ST launched at $52,605 and cars.com shows $49,000 (repackaged ST later in the model year); KBB's 2022 table confirms $49,000 as the late-2021 price.
2025: Tremor not listed on the 2025 cars.com page (not priced); Ford Authority's table gives no drivetrain for Active/ST-Line/Platinum.
Autoblog /buy/ pricing pages (2018 XLT 4x4) redirected to a section index; Edmunds was not available.
